items.title: Mali: Cholera Outbreak - Jul 2011
items.label: Foodborne & waterborne outbreak
items.detail: Affected country: Mali Glide: EP-2011-000112-MLI Starting in July 2012, a cholera outbreak occurred in the regions of Mopti and Tombouctou. Between 18-27 Jul 2011, a total of 258 cases, including 20 deaths, were recorded. ( IFRC, 30 Apr 2012
